info.name: Get Reporting Turns (division aware).

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor that points to the ID of the last item in the list of entities that has been returned.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Max number of entities to return. Maximum of 250

params.name: interval
params.description: Date range filter based on the date the individual resources were completed. UTC is the default if no TZ is supplied, however alternate timezones can be used e.g: '2022-11-22T09:11:11.111+08:00/2022-11-30T07:17:44.586-07'. . Intervals are represented as an ISO-8601 string. For example: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss/YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

params.name: actionId
params.description: Optional action ID to get the reporting turns associated to a particular flow action

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Optional session ID to get the reporting turns for a particular session. Specifying a session ID alongside an action ID or a language or any ask action results is not allowed.

params.name: language
params.description: Optional language code to get the reporting turns for a particular language

params.name: askActionResults
params.description: Optional case-insensitive comma separated list of ask action results to filter the reporting turns.

items.docs: Returns the reporting turns for the specified flow, filtered by the clients divisions and grouped by session, in reverse chronological order from the date the session was created, with the reporting turns from the most recent session appearing at the start of the list. info.name: Get Bot Flow Sessions.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor that points to the ID of the last item in the list of entities that has been returned.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Max number of entities to return. Maximum of 250

params.name: interval
params.description: Date range filter based on the date the individual resources were completed. UTC is the default if no TZ is supplied, however alternate timezones can be used e.g: '2022-11-22T09:11:11.111+08:00/2022-11-30T07:17:44.586-07'. . Intervals are represented as an ISO-8601 string. For example: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss/YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

params.name: botResultCategories
params.description: Optional case-insensitive comma separated list of Bot Result Categories to filter sessions by.

params.name: endLanguage
params.description: Optional case-insensitive language code to filter sessions by the language the sessions ended in.

items.docs: Returns the bot flow sessions in reverse chronological order from the date they were created. It is expected that the client will URL encode the request URI once only. For pagination, clients should keep sending requests using the value of 'nextUri' in the response, until it's no longer present, only then have all items have been returned. The 'nextUri' value in the response is already URL encoded (so it doesn't need to be encoded again). Note: resources returned by this endpoint are not persist
